anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23; it has no supply pin, driver output, pull-up, or other component connected to it.
anomalies.expected: LED anodes must be tied to a powered LED-supply net or driven source (for example +3V3 or the driven /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV net) so the LEDs can light when their cathode-side signals pull low.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet link/activity LEDs D4, D14, and D23 are left with floating anodes and will not operate as intended.

anomalies.observed: R36 is given schematic/SPICE value "24k", but its component description and MPN identify a 24Ω resistor.
anomalies.expected: The reference, value, description, and MPN should agree. In this position across VOUTP/VOUTN, a 24k bleed/load resistor is consistent with the 0805 125 mW rating and the surrounding clamp network; a 24Ω part would be an excessive load.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the board is assembled from the MPN/description part (24Ω) instead of the schematic value (24k), VOUTP/VOUTN would be heavily loaded and the resistor could over-dissipate, changing the power/clamp behavior.

anomalies.observed: The GND2 pins of the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected directly to the system GND net, and their VCC2 supply is the non-isolated switched 5V CAN rail.
anomalies.expected: For the intended isolated CAN buses, the transceiver secondary ground (GND2) and secondary supply should be isolated from the primary logic ground.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The CAN physical layer would not provide the intended galvanic isolation; the bus-side ground is tied to the board ground, defeating the isolated-CAN architecture and potentially introducing ground loops.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows at least three deviations from intended behavior: a floating LED-power net leaving D4/D14/D23 inoperative, a conflicting R36 value/MPN/description mismatch, and isolated CAN transceiver secondary grounds tied to system GND despite the specification calling for isolated CAN buses.
